items.title: Woman says Al Fayed's brother drugged and sexually abused her at Highland estate
items.summary: The woman says she was flown to the Fayed family's Balnagown estate, where she was repeatedly assaulted.

items.title: AI giant Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with 'Chinese spy'
items.summary: The chief executive of tech giant Nvidia has admitted having an affair, with the company investigating reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

items.title: Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week
items.summary: New petrol or diesel cars are due to be phased out by 2030 and by 2035 all new cars must be zero emission.

items.title: Finland's navy chief says Russia's presence in the Baltic Sea may have peaked for now
items.summary: Russia may have reached the limit of its "peacetime" ability to project force in the Baltic Sea, with the maritime situation "tense" but "stable", the head of Finland's navy has said.

items.title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says
items.summary: The education secretary says she is backing the inquiry to "get to the heart of the barriers holding children back".

items.title: Gunman suspected of killing six people in Polish city of Krakow has died, police say
items.summary: A gunman suspected of killing six people including a British national in Poland on Saturday has died in hospital.
